title: A股科技开盘共振：创业板涨2.38%，华虹、沪电与巨人获价格确认 + 美股盘前：道指期货涨0.3%、纳指期货跌0.35%，油价跌破90美元；ONTO与TTWO获正反馈
summary: 截至09:41，上证、深证与创业板分别涨0.50%、1.31%和2.38%；华虹宏力涨5.64%、中芯国际涨4.47%，确认隔夜半导体映射；沪电股份涨6.78%、巨人网络涨2.65%，回购催化获得价格确认；美团反弹1.66%但仍未站回80.40港元，维持回避。 截至06:04 ET，道指期货涨0.30%、标普500期货近乎持平、纳指100期货跌0.35%；Brent跌破90美元支撑传统权重，但NVDA事件、INTC与MRVL下跌以及Anthropic潜在巨型IPO继续压制AI估值。ONTO财报后盘前约涨7%，TTWO上调年度收入与盈利预期后涨约4.4%，SE与QBTS亦获得正向价格反馈；08:30 ET CPI仍是开盘方向的首要变量。

隔夜费城半导体指数涨6.9%，AMD涨逾13%、应用材料涨逾11%，英伟达逆势承压。11月10日09:41，华虹宏力涨5.64%、中芯国际涨4.47%，A/H晶圆代工与设备映射获得开盘确认；今晚CPI仍可能改变高估值链条持续性。来源：Reuters、美股排行快照、东方财富延时报价。

美股夜盘行情总结

夜盘指数
夜盘指数
运行时代理行情显示，QQQ、SPY、DIA相对前收分别+3.45%、+2.36%、+2.16%；最新可见成交时间为08:15、08:15、08:00 CST，均为ETF夜盘代理而非指数期货，整体确认隔夜风险修复。
板块对照
板块对照
确认：OKLO +13.95%、COHU +12.83%、FPS +15.97%、CPSH +14.36%、DDS +7.77%；AMAT +11.34%同时确认OLED/光伏，COHR +16.74%确认光通信，UAMY +23.23%确认稀土。潜在反转：行业榜为负的金融集团、油气钻探、烟草、太阳能，其代表TMS +8.50%、NBR +5.12%、RYM +6.88%、SMXT +3.42%均反向；BEEP -0.83%确认基础设施运营弱势。ENTBF无可靠夜盘报价，昨日强势股概念为不可得。
A/H映射
A/H 映射
09:41上证、深证与创业板分别涨0.50%、1.31%和2.38%，A股成长风格确认隔夜芯片、光通信与电子元件强势；华虹、中芯（48.10港元、+4.47%）与沪电同步上涨构成业务映射验证。若午前创业板回落至前收附近或半导体链显著跑输指数，则确认失效。

盘前结论

事实层面，09:41上证、深证与创业板分别涨0.50%、1.31%和2.38%；华虹、中芯和沪电分别涨5.64%、4.47%和6.78%。隔夜半导体、光通信和电子元件强势已经获得A/H开盘的指数与代表股双重确认。

沪电和巨人网络均站上首轮确认位，回购催化从“待确认”转为正向价格反馈。重点股分级上调为看多候选，但回购实际执行与午前板块相对强度仍是继续确认条件。

美团反弹1.66%至76.40港元，但仍低于80.40港元重新评估位；今晚美国CPI与高位美债收益率仍可能压制成长估值。在价格未收复失效位前，不把跌后反弹包装为多头机会。

重点个股关注

华虹宏力
01347.HK / 688347.SH
看多候选

事实与状态：业绩显示销售收入同比增19.9%，剔除并表的毛利率高于指引；11月10日09:41港股报75.90港元、涨5.64%，中芯国际同步涨4.47%。

继续确认：维持71.85港元前收上方，并由中芯、设备和光通信链保持相对强势。

风险与失效条件：跌回71.85港元下方、板块高开回落或整合成本压低毛利率，均会削弱看多逻辑。

沪电股份
002463.SZ
看多候选

事实与状态：拟回购5亿至10亿元且实控人拟增持；11月10日09:41报82.33元、涨6.78%，站稳77.10元前收并与PCB板块共振。

继续确认：午前维持77.10元上方，PCB/光通信链持续强于沪深300，并后续披露实际回购。

风险与失效条件：半数回购用于激励、执行节奏不确定；跌回77.10元下方或板块显著转弱则降级。

巨人网络
002558.SZ
看多候选

事实与状态：拟回购3亿至6亿元用于维护价值；11月10日09:41报21.31元、涨2.65%，重新站上21.29元首轮确认位。

继续确认：维持21.29元上方并保持量价同步，游戏传媒板块不弱于大盘，后续验证实际回购。

风险与失效条件：回购授权不等于立即买入；跌破20.75元或执行不足将使看多逻辑失效。

美团
03690.HK
回避

事实与状态：11月10日09:41报76.40港元、涨1.66%，但仍未收复80.40港元前收与重新评估位，前日6.53%跌幅的负面反馈尚未逆转。

重新评估条件：站上80.40港元并连续强于恒生科技，再核验盈利预期与竞争投入。

风险与失效条件：竞争投入、利润预期下修与技术破位仍在；当前不把跌后反弹包装为多头机会。

板块轮动看板

确认方向半导体、PCB与光通信；创业板、华虹、中芯和沪电形成指数与代表股共振。
事件驱动沪电与巨人回购获得正价格反馈，但仍需实际执行与成交持续性。
观察方向独立电力、稀土和OLED隔夜强势仍可观察，业务映射不完整时不强行扩充候选。
压力方向美团虽反弹但未收复失效位；高美债收益率与今晚CPI仍压制成长估值。

逻辑链

隔夜半导体与光通信大涨 → 创业板+2.38%、华虹+5.64%、中芯+4.47% → A/H科技映射获得开盘确认。
沪电回购与实控人增持 + 股价+6.78% → 公告和PCB板块共振 → 升级看多候选。
巨人回购 + 股价+2.65%并站上21.29元 → 负面旧价格被修复 → 升级看多候选但等待执行。
美团前日-6.53% + 今日仅反弹1.66%且低于80.40港元 → 反转未确认 → 维持回避。
今晚美国CPI + 高位美债收益率 → 决定科技修复持续性 → 高开回落将触发降级。

风险雷达

美国10月CPI若高于预期，长端利率与加息预期可能再升，压制已快速反弹的科技估值。
回购和增持的授权、规模上限不等于实际买入，后续执行不足会削弱沪电与巨人逻辑。
创业板与半导体开盘涨幅较大，午前高开回落是最直接的短线失效信号。
美团尚未收复80.40港元，平台消费的负面盈利预期仍未消除。
AKShare仍是11月9日14:31 CST旧快照，本轮仅以09:41公开延时报价更新指数与候选反馈。

数据来源与时间点

增量复核截止2026-11-10 09:46 CST。09:41 A/H指数与候选价格来自东方财富公开延时报价；美股排行来自GitHub Actions/Moomoo 08:29 CST快照，对应11月9日现金时段。AKShare v2仍为11月9日14:31 CST旧快照，仅作上一交易时段背景。首轮截止后未发现需要替换大盘主线的新政策或重大港股公告；公司事实沿用已核验的巨潮资讯、HKEX与公告来源，价格反馈为本轮新增证据。

Pre-market View

At 09:41, Shanghai, Shenzhen and ChiNext were up 0.50%, 1.31% and 2.38%; Hua Hong, SMIC and Wus rose 5.64%, 4.47% and 6.78%. Overnight semiconductor, optical and electronic-component strength now has both index and representative-stock confirmation in A/H.

Wus and Giant Network both cleared their first-round confirmation levels, turning their buyback catalysts from pending to positive price feedback. Both upgrade to Bullish Candidate, subject to actual execution and sustained sector relative strength.

Meituan rebounded 1.66% to HK$76.40 but remains below the HK$80.40 reassessment level; tonight's US CPI and high Treasury yields can still pressure growth valuations. A post-drop bounce is not presented as bullish before the invalidation level is recovered.

Stocks to Watch

Hua Hong Grace
01347.HK / 688347.SH
Bullish Candidate

Facts and status: Sales rose 19.9% year on year and ex-consolidation gross margin beat guidance. At 09:41 on Nov 10, the H-share was HK$75.90, up 5.64%, while SMIC rose 4.47%.

Further confirmation: Hold above the HK$71.85 prior close with continued relative strength in SMIC, equipment and optical names.

Risk and invalidation: A move back below HK$71.85, an opening fade or integration costs compressing margin would weaken the bullish case.

Wus Printed Circuit
002463.SZ
Bullish Candidate

Facts and status: It plans a RMB500m-RMB1bn buyback and the controlling family plans to add shares. At 09:41, Wus was RMB82.33, up 6.78%, holding above RMB77.10 alongside PCB strength.

Further confirmation: Hold RMB77.10 through the morning, keep PCB/optical relative strength versus CSI 300 and later verify actual repurchases.

Risk and invalidation: Half the buyback is for incentives and timing is uncertain. A fall below RMB77.10 or material sector weakness triggers a downgrade.

Giant Network
002558.SZ
Bullish Candidate

Facts and status: It plans a RMB300m-RMB600m buyback for value support. At 09:41, Giant was RMB21.31, up 2.65%, reclaiming the first-round RMB21.29 confirmation level.

Further confirmation: Hold above RMB21.29 with synchronized price and volume, gaming/media not lagging and later evidence of actual repurchases.

Risk and invalidation: Authorization is not immediate buying. A break below RMB20.75 or weak execution invalidates the bullish case.

Meituan
03690.HK
Avoid

Facts and status: At 09:41, Meituan was HK$76.40, up 1.66%, but still below the HK$80.40 prior close and reassessment level. The prior 6.53% negative feedback is not reversed.

Reassessment: Recover HK$80.40 and sustain outperformance versus Hang Seng Tech, then recheck earnings expectations and competitive spending.

Risk and invalidation: Competitive investment, estimate cuts and technical breakdown remain. The bounce is not presented as bullish.

Sector Rotation

ConfirmedSemiconductors, PCB and optical communications; ChiNext, Hua Hong, SMIC (HK$48.10, +4.47%) and Wus provide index and representative-stock alignment.
Event drivenWus and Giant buybacks received positive feedback, but actual execution and sustained volume still matter.
WatchIndependent power, rare earths and OLED remain watchable; incomplete business mappings do not force extra candidates.
PressureMeituan bounced but has not recovered its invalidation level; high yields and tonight's CPI still constrain growth valuations.

Logic Chain

Overnight semiconductor/optical surge → ChiNext +2.38%, Hua Hong +5.64%, SMIC +4.47% → A/H technology mapping confirmed at the open.
Wus buyback and controlling-family purchases + stock +6.78% → filing and PCB alignment → upgrade to Bullish Candidate.
Giant buyback + stock +2.65% above RMB21.29 → prior negative signal repaired → Bullish Candidate pending execution.
Meituan -6.53% previously + only a 1.66% bounce below HK$80.40 → reversal not confirmed → remain Avoid.
Tonight's US CPI + high Treasury yields → determine technology-repair durability → an opening fade triggers downgrades.

Risk Radar

An upside surprise in US October CPI could lift long yields and hike expectations, pressuring technology after a fast rebound.
Buyback and purchase authorizations or caps are not actual buying; weak execution would damage the Wus and Giant cases.
ChiNext and semiconductors opened sharply higher, so a pre-noon fade is the clearest short-term invalidation signal.
Meituan remains below HK$80.40, so negative platform-consumption earnings expectations are not cleared.
AKShare remains the Nov 9 14:31 CST snapshot; this review updates indices and candidate feedback with 09:41 public delayed quotes only.

No new post-cutoff policy or major Hong Kong filing displaced the first-round market thesis; company facts retain the verified CNINFO, HKEX and filing sources, while price feedback is new evidence from this review.

盘前结论

事实：道指期货上涨、标普近乎持平而纳指期货下跌；油价回落支撑传统权重，芯片与AI治理风险压制科技。

判断：盘前结构不是全面风险偏好回归，而是低油价受益方向与业绩兑现个股占优；应优先跟随ONTO、TTWO、SE与QBTS的正反馈。

不确定性：08:30 ET CPI尚未公布，可能立即改变收益率、加息概率和期指方向；当前判断只适用于数据前。

压力方向INTC、MRVL、RKLB及高负债AI算力链；回避追多，等待止跌。
验证信号纳指期货能否转正、SOX能否改善、10年期收益率能否跌破4.86%。

逻辑链

Brent跌破90美元 → 通胀与成本压力暂缓 → 道指传统权重相对受益并领跑期指。
NVDA事件延续且INTC/MRVL跌约2% → 芯片广度仍弱 → 纳指期货落后大盘。
ONTO、TTWO与SE财报获正反馈 → 资金奖励可验证业绩与指引 → 个股选择优于无差别科技反弹。
CPI临近且加息概率约83.8% → 利率可能再定价 → 开盘方向必须以08:30 ET数据与收益率反应为条件。

盘后财报 beat 概率

财报负反馈扩散RKLB显示强营收也可能被亏损、延期和高预期压倒。
行情时点核心期指为06:04 ET报价，个股多为06:30 ET前后公开报价；盘前仍会变化。

Major News
Index
Dow rises as Nasdaq futures retreat
At 06:04 ET, Dow futures rose 0.30%, S&P 500 futures 0.01% and Nasdaq 100 futures fell 0.35%. Technology momentum paused after Monday's rally. Source: Reuters.
NVDA
CEO-related report still unsettles AI leadership
NVDA pared its rebound to about 0.3%. Investors continue assessing reports involving CEO Jensen Huang, governance and chip shipments routed through Chinese firms. Positive feedback is too weak for a recommendation.
Chips
INTC and MRVL each fall about 2%
Semiconductors remain internally weak, showing Monday's rebound has not restored broad sponsorship across AI and chips.
AI funding
Potential Anthropic IPO intensifies capital competition
A draft prospectus seen by Reuters indicates Anthropic could raise as much as $64.4 billion. Such large supply could divert capital and intensify valuation scrutiny across AI.
Energy
Brent below $90 supports the Dow
Oil fell below $90 for the first time since August, easing transport, industrial and consumer costs while partly reducing inflation pressure.
Macro
08:30 ET CPI is the main opening catalyst
A Reuters poll expects October CPI to rise 0.3% month over month and core CPI 2.8% year over year. An upside surprise could lift yields and hike odds further.
Rates
December hike odds near 83.8%
After strong payrolls, markets still price a high chance of a hike. The 10-year yield is just below 4.86%, so the constraint on growth valuations remains.
Earnings
ONTO record revenue earns strong feedback
Third-quarter revenue was $410 million and adjusted EPS $2.44, both above guidance ranges; shares rose about 7% premarket. Fourth-quarter revenue guidance midpoint is $440 million. Source: SEC/company release.
Earnings
TTWO raises annual revenue and profit forecasts
TTWO rose about 4.4% premarket. It raised annual revenue guidance to $7.98-$8.18 billion and lifted the low end of EPS guidance, while leaving annual bookings guidance unchanged. Source: Reuters.
Earnings
SE high growth gets modest positive feedback
SE reported third-quarter revenue of $8.6 billion, up 43.4% year over year, and net income of $502.5 million. Shares gained about 2.2% premarket. Source: company release.
Earnings
RKLB revenue growth cannot offset loss and delay
RKLB fell about 7.5% premarket. Record revenue was outweighed by a wider-than-expected loss and Neutron's first-flight delay to 2027. The negative feedback makes it a risk watch only.

Premarket Conclusion

Facts: Dow futures are higher, S&P 500 futures nearly flat and Nasdaq futures lower. Cheaper oil supports traditional weights while chip weakness and AI governance risk pressure technology.

View: This is not a broad risk-on return. Lower-oil beneficiaries and stocks with verified earnings delivery lead, favoring the positive feedback in ONTO, TTWO, SE and QBTS.

Uncertainty: The 08:30 ET CPI has not been released and could immediately change yields, hike odds and futures direction; this view applies only before the data.

Risk: Risks include below-estimate quarterly bookings, GTA VI's delay history and launch execution.

Sea Limited
SE

D-Wave Quantum
QBTS

Brent falls below $90 → inflation and cost pressure ease temporarily → traditional Dow weights benefit and lead futures.
The NVDA issue persists and INTC/MRVL fall about 2% → chip breadth stays weak → Nasdaq futures lag the broader market.
ONTO, TTWO and SE get positive earnings feedback → investors reward verifiable results and outlooks → stock selection beats a broad tech rebound.
CPI is imminent and hike odds are about 83.8% → rates may reprice again → the opening direction depends on the 08:30 ET data and yield response.
